hints.title: Chunk Partitioning
hints.text: Notice that since both strings are split into k equal chunks, each chunk must have length exactly n divided by k.

hints.title: Multiset Equivalence
hints.text: Rearranging chunks is possible if and only if the collection of chunks from s matches the collection of chunks from t.

hints.title: Frequency Comparison
hints.text: Count the frequency of each chunk in both s and t and verify whether their counts match.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: length of strings s and t
complexity.notes: Partition both strings into k chunks of size n/k and compare frequency distributions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all k! permutations of substrings takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory stores the substring frequencies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Partitions both strings into equal blocks and checks multiset equality.
